name: pon_reverse_handover
label: Dirty Boots repair followed by reverse handover
description: Plant repair restores optics, but service remains degraded and the same incident returns to Clean Boots.

evidence.subject: ONT-6001
evidence.summary: Initial optical condition is below threshold.

evidence.subject: SVC-6001
evidence.summary: Customer also reports persistent in-home Wi-Fi degradation.

deterministic_rca.cause: The initial optical impairment is localized at the ODP.

llm_rca.cause: Repair the optical boundary first, then verify the customer experience.

post_failure_rca.cause: Optics are restored; residual degradation is now inside the customer domain.

expected_outcome: The same incident and SLA clock return from Dirty Boots to Clean Boots and close after validation.
